title: Journey of Souls: Case Studies of Life Between Lives
author: Michael Newton, Ph.D.
target_audience: Individuals interested in past life regression and reincarnation
Spiritual seekers exploring life after death concepts
Readers curious about consciousness and the soul
Therapists, counselors, and those in healing professions
General audience open to esoteric and metaphysical topics
core_themes: Continuity and immortality of the soul
Experiences and life lessons between incarnations
Structure and organization of the spirit world
Soul groups and relationships across lifetimes
primary_purpose: To present evidence-based narratives from hypnosis case studies that reveal what happens to souls between physical incarnations, offering readers a detailed, systematic exploration of the afterlife and soul evolution.

structure_format.narrative_style: Objective, scientific, yet accessible; case study-driven
structure_format.organization: Divided into discrete chapters themed around stages of the soul’s existence between lives, each illustrated by various client case transcripts

key_concepts_lessons: Souls undergo a journey of growth and learning beyond physical existence.
Life between lives involves introspection, healing, meeting soul groups, and planning future incarnations.
Death and the afterlife are described as peaceful, loving, and purposeful experiences.
Individuals frequently reincarnate with familiar souls, fulfilling mutual goals.
Karmic lessons and spiritual progression are central to the soul’s experiences.
Consciousness transcends the physical body and continues in other realms.
notable_features: Over two dozen real-life regression case studies
Novel framework for understanding the soul’s existence between lives
Accessible blend of clinical hypnosis and metaphysical inquiry
Pioneering the Life Between Lives (LBL) regression technique
cultural_historical_context: Published in the early 1990s, the book built on the rising popularity of past life regression and New Age spirituality, bridging clinical hypnosis practices with metaphysical exploration at a time when reincarnation and spiritual consciousness were gaining mainstream curiosity in the West.
reception_impact: Achieved cult status among New Age and spiritual readers
Widely cited as foundational in the field of Life Between Lives regression therapy
Praised for its rigorous documentation and compassionate tone
Criticized by skeptics for methodological limitations and reliance on hypnotic recall
Contributed to subsequent books, studies, and training programs on spiritual regression
comparable_titles: Destiny of Souls by Michael Newton
Many Lives, Many Masters by Brian L. Weiss
Soul Survivor by Bruce and Andrea Leininger
Life Between Lives by Joel L. Whitton and Joe Fisher
